matching_policy.unit_constraints: Each candidate is assigned to at most one truth unit, and each truth unit has at most one candidate representative.
matching_policy.chain_rule: A composite is exact only if every essential link and the final composed oracle are demonstrated; separately found primitives do not imply the composite.

truth_units.title: Compound AMM and vault-rate amplification makes a flash-funded reserve drain profitable
truth_units.rationale: No candidate demonstrates a single profitable composed execution that combines reserve spot manipulation with posted-share exchange-rate inflation, repays the flash principal and fee, and reaches the retained-profit and market-reserve-loss oracle.

chain_handling.decision: No inferred credit. C-008 reproduces F-02, while C-011 earns only partial F-03 credit on a different vault use path; neither candidate, separately or together, demonstrates the committed atomic multiplication and final oracle.

truth_units.title: Fallback price uses an instantaneous constant-product reserve ratio
truth_units.rationale: C-008 reproduces the nonpositive-feed trigger, instantaneous permissionlessly manipulated ReservePool ratio, immediate LendingMarket consumption, and profitable undercollateralized borrowing. Its approximately 3.994x price movement differs from the canonical fixture's larger movement but reaches the same lending-impact oracle under allowed assumptions.

chain_handling.decision: Credited independently as F-02 only; it does not imply F-01.

truth_units.title: Unsolicited vault balances inflate collateral exchange rates
truth_units.rationale: C-011 reproducibly shows that a direct donation enters totalAssets and inflates the exchange rate, which is the committed vault-rate primitive. It exercises convertToShares and deposit denial at tiny supply, not posted collateral, convertToAssets, LendingMarket valuation, or the increased borrow-limit oracle, so it cannot be exact.

chain_handling.decision: Partial primitive credit only. The report cannot be combined with C-008 to infer F-01.

compatibility_points.basis: The canonical partial band explicitly awards 2 points for donation/inflation awareness without connection to posted collateral; the Low-versus-Medium cap is non-binding.

severity_comparison.note: The Low rating is well supported for C-011's demonstrated transient denial, but it is one rank below the matched canonical unit's Medium severity.

truth_units.title: Borrow callback reenters collateral withdrawal before debt is committed
truth_units.rationale: C-001 reproduces the same debt-after-callback ordering defect and shows a nested borrow observing stale debt, producing 1,500 debt against a 750 limit. It does not reenter withdrawCollateral, recover the posted shares, or demonstrate the canonical zero-local-collateral oracle, so the affected reentrant edge and final state are incomplete.

chain_handling.decision: Partial credit for the same reproducible state-ordering defect, not a second independent truth unit.

compatibility_points.basis: Top partial-band award for a runnable, quantified exploit of the exact callback-before-debt defect without the committed borrow-to-withdraw proof. The generic 80% one-level overcall cap does not further bind the 5-point partial award.

truth_units.title: Collateral-factor authorization condition permits public increases
truth_units.rationale: C-006 reproduces the inverted non-guardian branch, raises the factor from 7,500 to 9,500 bps, and demonstrates borrowing above the former limit. Immediate bad debt is not required by this canonical unit.

compatibility_points.basis: Exact detection capped by the explicit Medium-or-lower canonical severity rule.

truth_units.title: withdraw rounds share burns down and can burn zero shares
truth_units.rationale: No candidate identifies previewWithdraw/withdraw floor rounding, a feasible zero-share burn, or asset withdrawal without supply reduction.

truth_units.title: Vault deposit mints from requested rather than received assets
truth_units.rationale: No candidate demonstrates nominal-versus-received deposit accounting, fee-on-transfer share overminting, incumbent dilution, or a profitable deposit/redeem cycle.

chain_handling.decision: No credit; F-07 and F-14 remain distinct accounting invariants.

truth_units.title: Transfer authorization has no chain or verifying-contract domain
truth_units.rationale: C-010 identifies the omitted verifier and chain domain, independent per-router nonces, required approvals and nonce alignment, and executes identical signature bytes on two router instances for twice the authorized transfer.

chain_handling.decision: Credited separately from recipient substitution because the signed-field fix and prerequisites differ.

compatibility_points.basis: Exact detection capped by the explicit Medium-or-lower canonical severity rule.

truth_units.title: Transfer authorization does not bind its recipient
truth_units.rationale: C-003 identifies recipient's omission from the signed type and payload, substitutes an attacker recipient, transfers the full signed amount, and consumes the owner's nonce.

truth_units.title: Bridge finalization ignores the authenticated remote sender
truth_units.rationale: C-002 demonstrates that xDomainMessageSender is read but not compared with the configured remote, relays from a mismatching remote, creates 1,000 unbacked bridge shares, and borrows 750 stable against the fabricated credit.

chain_handling.decision: Credited separately from nonce namespacing because the cause, impact, and fix differ.

truth_units.title: Bridge replay state collides across configured source chains
truth_units.class: cross-chain replay namespace / denial of service
truth_units.rationale: C-007 configures two independent source chains, relays equal nonces from their legitimate configured remotes, and shows the second valid credit is denied because processedNonce omits sourceChain.

truth_units.title: Strategy initialization can be repeated to seize the operator role
truth_units.rationale: C-005 reproduces post-initialization role overwrite by an arbitrary caller, then uses the seized operator role to sweep the entire funded module balance and confirms the seized vault execute authority.

compatibility_points.basis: full exact band using the frozen consensus High severity, not the hunter's unreviewed Critical label

truth_units.title: Primary oracle path accepts expired price rounds
truth_units.rationale: C-009 identifies discarded timestamp and round-completeness metadata, advances time by a year, and uses the stale positive two-dollar answer to borrow 1,500 against a contemporaneous one-dollar comparator that permits 750.

truth_units.title: Repayment extinguishes nominal debt despite transfer-fee shortfall
truth_units.rationale: No candidate identifies nominal debt reduction despite a smaller received balance delta or demonstrates settled debt with a reserve deficit under a fee-bearing stable asset.

chain_handling.decision: No credit; no inference from any vault claim.

truth_units.title: Signature-byte replay key is bypassed with ECDSA malleability
truth_units.rationale: C-004 reproduces high-s/low-s equivalent recovery, distinct raw signature hashes, and repeated payment for one payload. Consensus strengthened the demonstrated bound to four accepted raw encodings, which includes and exceeds the committed duplicate-payment oracle without changing the root cause.

candidate_dispositions.rationale: Same callback-before-debt defect, but nested borrow replaces the committed borrow-to-withdraw edge and zero-collateral oracle.

Exact cross-chain nonce-namespace collision and local credit denial.
Exact fallback spot manipulation and profitable lending impact; does not earn F-01 composite credit.
Exact stale-positive primary-feed acceptance and undercollateralized borrowing.
Exact cross-router verifier-domain replay; frozen severity is one rank below canonical.
Reproduces direct-donation exchange-rate inflation, but only on the first-share deposit-denial path and without the committed lending integration.

cluster_handling.note: All 11 frozen clusters were reproduced and in scope. Every cluster matched one committed unit exactly or partially, so there are no unmatched novel-valid clusters and no false positives.
